notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Staiton.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
